leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Install and configure React Router DOM to set up routing in a TypeScript React application
Define route configurations using the Routes and Route components to map URLs to components
Implement navigation between pages using the Link component with proper TypeScript typing
Apply the useParams hook to access dynamic route parameters within component logic
Utilize the useNavigate hook to programmatically control navigation based on user interactions
Construct nested route structures to organize related pages within a hierarchical layout
Implement route protection patterns using conditional rendering to control component access
Handle 404 scenarios by implementing a catch-all route with appropriate fallback components
Apply TypeScript interfaces to type-check route parameters and navigation state objects
Configure browser history management to maintain navigation state across user sessions
Implement query parameter handling using URLSearchParams to filter and sort displayed data
Construct reusable navigation components with active link styling using NavLink properties
